summary: Alibaba Group Holding Limited furnished a Form -6K containing its October 2026 Hong Kong Stock Exchange monthly return (equivalent to a US periodic share-capital update), filed under HK Listing Rule 13.25B. Authorized share capital held at 32,000,000,000 ordinary shares (par US$0.000003125, total US$100,000) and issued shares excluding treasury remained 19,901,959,514, with no month-over-month change in either authorized or issued capital or treasury shares. The company confirmed compliance with the 25% initial public float threshold. No transaction, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor or regulatory clock is disclosed; a routine administrative filing with no deal terms to monitor.
